rate.praise: Tight registry pattern, no defensive noise, paths computed once at module level, and `cosine_from_parts` is three lines doing exactly what it says.

cuts.issue: The slice `[:, 1:, :, 1:]` is repeated three times — one typo breaks only one of the three silently.
cuts.fix: Hoist: `s = (slice(None), slice(1,None), slice(None), slice(1,None)); return ab[s].einsum('ijij->') / (aa[s].einsum('ijij->').sqrt() * bb[s].einsum('ijij->').sqrt())` — or accept it as-is if the repetition is intentional documentation of what each tensor skips.
